description: Tool to create a Stripe Payment Link. Use when you need to generate a hosted checkout page URL that can be shared with customers to collect payments without building custom checkout infrastructure. Supports up to 20 line items per payment link.

inputSchema.description: Request to create a Stripe Payment Link.

after_completion.description: Behavior after the purchase is complete.

custom_message.description: A custom message to display to the customer after the purchase is complete.
custom_message.title: Custom Message

url.description: The URL the customer will be redirected to after the purchase is complete.
url.title: Url

type.description: The specified behavior after the purchase is complete. Either 'redirect' or 'hosted_confirmation'.
type.title: Type

after_completion.title: AfterCompletion

application_fee_amount.description: The amount of the application fee (if any) that will be requested to be applied to the payment and transferred to the application owner's Stripe account.
application_fee_amount.title: Application Fee Amount

application_fee_percent.description: A non-negative decimal between 0 and 100, with at most two decimal places. This represents the percentage of the subscription invoice total that will be transferred to the application owner's Stripe account.
application_fee_percent.title: Application Fee Percent

enabled.description: If true, tax will be calculated automatically using Stripe Tax.
enabled.title: Enabled

account.description: The connected account being referenced when type is 'account'.
account.title: Account

type.description: Type of the liability account. Either 'account' or 'self'.
type.title: Type

billing_address_collection.description: Configuration for collecting the customer's billing address. Either 'auto' or 'required'.
billing_address_collection.title: Billing Address Collection

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase. Must be a supported currency and supported by each line item's price.
currency.title: Currency

customer_creation.description: Configures whether checkout sessions created by this payment link create a customer. Either 'if_required' or 'always'. Note: This parameter cannot be used if the payment link contains any recurring prices (subscriptions).
customer_creation.title: Customer Creation

inactive_message.description: The custom message to be displayed to a customer when a payment link is no longer active.
inactive_message.title: Inactive Message

enabled.description: Whether to create an invoice for the payment.
enabled.title: Enabled

line_items.description: The line items representing what is being sold. Each payment link can have up to 20 line items.

items.description: Line item representing what is being sold.

enabled.description: Set to true if the quantity can be adjusted to any non-negative integer.
enabled.title: Enabled

maximum.description: The maximum quantity the customer can purchase. By default this is 99. The maximum value supported is 999999.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: The minimum quantity the customer can purchase. By default this is 0.
minimum.title: Minimum

price.description: The ID of an existing Stripe Price or Plan object (e.g., 'price_1MoBy5LkdIwHu7ixZhnattbh' or 'plan_ABC123'). This references a pre-created price in your Stripe account. Do NOT pass a literal numerical amount here. If you want to specify a monetary amount directly (e.g., $52), use the price_data field instead with unit_amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 5200 for $52.00). One of price or price_data is required.
price.title: Price

price_data.description: Inline Price creation for line items.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase. Must be a supported currency.
currency.title: Currency

product.description: The ID of the product that this price will belong to. One of product or product_data is required.
product.title: Product

description.description: The product's description, meant to be displayable to the customer.
description.title: Description

images.description: A list of up to 8 URLs of images for this product, meant to be displayable to the customer.
images.title: Images

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: The product's display name, meant to be displayable to the customer.
name.title: Name

tax_code.description: A tax code ID that indicates the product's taxability.
tax_code.title: Tax Code

interval.description: Specifies billing frequency. One of 'day', 'week', 'month', or 'year'.
interval.title: Interval

interval_count.description: The number of intervals between subscription billings. For example, interval=month and interval_count=3 bills every 3 months. Maximum of one year interval allowed (1 year, 12 months, or 52 weeks).
interval_count.title: Interval Count

tax_behavior.description: Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of 'inclusive', 'exclusive', or 'unspecified'. Once specified, it cannot be changed.
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

unit_amount.description: A positive integer in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents for $1.00) representing how much to charge. One of unit_amount or unit_amount_decimal is required.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Same as unit_amount, but accepts a decimal value representing an integer in the smallest currency unit. One of unit_amount or unit_amount_decimal is required.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

price_data.title: PriceData

quantity.description: The quantity of the line item being purchased.
quantity.title: Quantity

items.title: LineItem

line_items.title: Line Items

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
metadata.title: Metadata

on_behalf_of.description: The account on behalf of which to charge.
on_behalf_of.title: On Behalf Of

payment_method_collection.description: Configuration for collecting a payment method during checkout. Either 'always' or 'if_required'.
payment_method_collection.title: Payment Method Collection

payment_method_types.description: The list of payment method types that customers can use. Defaults to ['card'] which is universally supported. You can specify multiple types like ['card', 'us_bank_account'] based on your needs.
payment_method_types.title: Payment Method Types

phone_number_collection.description: Configuration for collecting the customer's phone number at checkout. Example: {'enabled': true}
phone_number_collection.title: Phone Number Collection

allowed_countries.description: An array of two-letter ISO country codes representing which countries Checkout should provide as options for shipping locations.
allowed_countries.title: Allowed Countries

submit_type.description: Describes the type of transaction being performed by Checkout in order to customize relevant text on the page, such as the submit button. Either 'auto', 'book', 'donate', 'pay', or 'subscribe'.
submit_type.title: Submit Type

subscription_data.description: When creating a subscription, the specified configuration data will be used. Metadata as key-value pairs.
subscription_data.title: Subscription Data

tax_id_collection.description: Configuration for collecting the customer's tax ID at checkout. Example: {'enabled': true}
tax_id_collection.title: Tax Id Collection

transfer_data.description: The account (if any) the payments will be attributed to for tax reporting, and where funds from each payment will be transferred to. Contains destination and optionally amount.
transfer_data.title: Transfer Data
